# The Septic Guide

> Independent, homeowner-focused resource on septic tanks, drainfields, pumping schedules, and septic-safe products.

The Septic Guide is an independent publication for the 20 percent of U.S. households on private septic systems. Content covers system types (conventional, mound, aerobic), maintenance, inspection, problem diagnosis, product reviews of septic-safe household consumables, and cost guides for pumping, repair, replacement, and sewer conversion. Homeowners can request free quotes from vetted septic professionals through partner Networx.

## Cost Guides & Calculators

- [Drain Field Replacement Cost 2026: Average Prices & Full Breakdown](https://theseptic.guide/cost-guides/drainfield-replacement-cost): Drain field replacement costs $5,000 to $20,000 on average. New drainfield installation, partial repair, and alternative system costs compared with what drives the price in your area.
- [Septic Inspection Cost 2026: What Each Type Costs and What\u2019s Actually Included](https://theseptic.guide/cost-guides/septic-inspection-cost): A septic inspection costs $150 to $650 depending on the type. Compare visual, routine, comprehensive, and real estate inspection costs, what each includes, hidden fees, and how to choose an inspector.
- [Septic Tank & Drainfield Installation Cost 2026: Complete Price Breakdown](https://theseptic.guide/cost-guides/septic-system-installation-cost): How much does it cost to install a septic system? New septic tank and drainfield installation costs $3,000 to $20,000 depending on system type, soil conditions, and location.
- [Septic Tank & Drain Field Repair Cost 2026: Every Repair Priced](https://theseptic.guide/cost-guides/septic-system-repair-cost): Septic tank repair costs $500 to $3,000. Drain field repair runs $1,500 to $20,000 depending on damage. Covers baffle replacement, pump repair, root removal, and full drainfield restoration.
- [Septic System Cost Calculator 2026: New Install, Tank and Drainfield Replacement](https://theseptic.guide/cost-guides/septic-tank-cost-calculator): Estimate septic system cost for new installs, tank-only replacement, drainfield replacement, or full system replacement. Adjust for system type, bedrooms, soil difficulty, tank material, and region...
- [Septic to Sewer Conversion Cost 2026: Complete Price Breakdown](https://theseptic.guide/cost-guides/septic-to-sewer-conversion-cost): Septic to sewer conversion costs $5,000 to $15,000 in 2026, with a national average of $7,000 to $10,000. Full cost breakdown, when conversion makes financial sense, and available grants.
